description: Part 10 lesson 10-03 (Capstone C and D). Real runs 2026-09-30 (2nd run: all criteria met; NEWBUILD OBJATTRIBUTE is RPGLE). ONE connection, ONE cl wrapper job. The first cl step CURSET makes the work library the current library, because a harness job starts with the private dev library as CURLIB and ZA0500, ZAISRV and the SQL cursors resolve JUCHUD/JUCHUM/ZAIKOM through the library list (without CURSET a *LIVE pass could update the private ZAIKOM). Order: (1) rebuild the legacy ZA0500 (src/legacy) and the ticket-1-fixed JU0900C, TXRESET, run JU0900C with PARM *TEST and print a marker before it: the printed lines are the legacy golden master (12 lines, OK 10, SHORT 2, NOTFOUND 0; expected/golden-test-12.txt; the printed text of a qsh-started job is captured in the run section, not a real spool file, so TXSNAP/CMPPFM stay V3 and the comparison is done locally on the run text); (2) separate *LIVE pass with the legacy program, ZAIKOM copied into VFYZLEG, TXRESET before and after; (3) CRTDUPOBJ backup ZA0ORIG into the backup library, build ZAISRV/ZAISRVBD/JUCSRV/JUCSRVBD/TESTKIT/TESTKITBD/TSTJUCSRV/TSTZAISRV/TSTZA0500/RUNTEST from source in the work library (closest safe alternative to promoting from the private dev library, which a batch must never touch), then CRTSQLRPGI of solutions/10-03/za0500s.sqlrpgle over ZA0500 (member form, COMMIT(*NONE), REPLACE(*YES); the binding directory is named by ctl-opt bnddir in the source because the command reference lists no BNDDIR or TGTCCSID keyword for CRTSQLRPGI); the stream-file spellings (design line with TGTCCSID and BNDDIR, CVTCCSID(*JOB), COMPILEOPT) are tried at run time through QCMDEXC on a scratch program ZA0STM by the helper ZA0STMB, one message each; (4) new ZA0500 through JU0900C: *TEST twice in the same job (second call OK, so no lock or ODP leak), then TXRESET, *LIVE pass with the ZAIKOM copy VFYZNEW and TXRESET again; the EXCEPT collects compare VFYZLEG and VFYZNEW (the printed *LIVE block of the legacy pass, after the marker LEGACY LIVE, is expected to equal expected/live-predicted-12.txt too; a difference there is a finding, not a harness error); (5) RUNTEST once (CHGCURLIB, DELETE FROM TESTRES, ZAIKOM isolated in QTEMP, TSTJUCSRV, TSTZAISRV, TSTZA0500; expected message RUNTEST: PASS=0000000038 FAIL=0000000000, ten digit zero padded like TXCHECK, = 23 existing rows + 15 new); (6) TXCKM rows for 10-03 and TXCHKRUN once (expected 6 passed 0 failed), the rows are copied to VFYCKM and deleted from TXCKM at the end; (7) rollback (delete ZA0500, CRTDUPOBJ ZA0ORIG back) and the *TEST run again, which must print the golden master; VFYATTR records OBJATTRIBUTE of ZA0500 as LEGACY, NEWBUILD, ROLLBACK so a failed compile cannot pass as a match (legacy is RPG, the new one must not be RPG: SQLRPGLE or RPGLE). Then after the wrapper, in separate qsh jobs: makei attempt on a flat clone built from the members (Rules.mk with ZAISRV and ZA0500 rules, objects go to the backup library and are deleted again; whether makei supports .sqlrpgle and a *PGM that binds a *SRVPGM is UNVERIFIED and is recorded either way). The makei copy of the source has the ctl-opt keywords dftactgrp and actgrp removed by a python step (ACTGRP is valid only for CRTBNDRPG, and makei builds a *MODULE first). JU0900C stays the ticket-1 version in the work library afterwards (TXLEGACY FORCE(*YES) resets it); ZA0500 ends as the legacy program. rpglint is NOT run here (learner-side tool, local only). Never run without reading the results section by section; ZAIKOM is restored with TXRESET at the end.

steps.label: MKSTMFDIR
steps.cmd: mkdir -p "$HOME/vfy/part10-03-modernize/stmf" 2>&1

steps.label: CURSET

steps.label: RSTA

steps.label: CPZALEG

DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/ZA0500)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: MKLEGT

steps.label: RSTB

steps.label: MKLEGL

steps.label: RSTC

steps.label: BKUPZA

steps.label: CPZAISM

steps.label: CPZAISS

steps.label: CPZAISBD
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/ZAISRVBD) OBJTYPE(*BNDDIR)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTBNDDIR BNDDIR(&LIB/ZAISRVBD))
ADDBNDDIRE BNDDIR(&LIB/ZAISRVBD) OBJ((*LIBL/ZAISRV *SRVPGM))
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: CPJUCSM
steps.cmd: CRTRPGMOD MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(JUCSRV) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPJUCSS

steps.label: CPJUCSBD
steps.cmd:

MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTBNDDIR BNDDIR(&LIB/JUCSRVBD))

steps.label: CPTKMOD

steps.label: CPTKSRV
steps.cmd: CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/TESTKIT) MODULE(&LIB/TESTKIT) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCFILE(&LIB/QSRVSRC) SRCMBR(TESTKIT) ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPTSTJUC
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/TSTJUCSRV) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(TSTJUCSRV) DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(*NEW) BNDDIR((*LIBL/JUCSRVBD) (*LIBL/TESTKITBD)) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPTSTZAI

steps.label: CPTSTZA05
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/TSTZA0500) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(TSTZA0500) DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(*NEW) BNDDIR((*LIBL/ZAISRVBD) (*LIBL/TESTKITBD)) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: MKISETUP
steps.cmd:
rm -rf "$HOME/mk10"
mkdir -p "$HOME/mk10/z"
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QRPGLESRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk10/z/zaisrv.rpgle') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QSRVSRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk10/z/zaisrv.bnd') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QRPGLESRC.FILE/ZA0500.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk10/z/za0500s.sqlrpgle') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "p='$HOME/mk10/z/za0500s.sqlrpgle'; d=open(p,'rb').read(); open(p,'wb').write(d.replace(b'dftactgrp(*no) actgrp(*new) ', b''))"
echo ---CTL-OPT---
/QOpenSys/usr/bin/grep -n ctl-opt "$HOME/mk10/z/za0500s.sqlrpgle" </dev/null
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "open('$HOME/mk10/z/Rules.mk','wb').write(b'ZAISRV.MODULE: zaisrv.rpgle\nZAISRV.SRVPGM: ZAISRV.MODULE zaisrv.bnd\nZA0500.MODULE: za0500s.sqlrpgle\nZA0500.PGM: ZA0500.MODULE ZAISRV.SRVPGM\n')"
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "open('$HOME/mk10/z/iproj.json','wb').write(b'{\"version\":\"0.0.1\",\"objlib\":\"&LIB2\",\"curlib\":\"&LIB2\",\"postUsrlibl\":' + bytes([91]) + b'\"&LIB\"' + bytes([93]) + b'}')"
echo ---RULES-MK---
cat "$HOME/mk10/z/Rules.mk" </dev/null
echo ---IPROJ-JSON---
cat "$HOME/mk10/z/iproj.json" </dev/null
echo

steps.label: MKIBUILD
steps.cmd: /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/bash -c 'cd "$HOME/mk10/z" && export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/makei build' </dev/null 2>&1

rm -rf "$HOME/mk10" 2>&1
rm -rf "$HOME/vfy/part10-03-modernize/stmf" 2>&1

steps.sql: SELECT TAG, OBJNAME, ATTR FROM &LIB/VFYATTR ORDER BY 1
SELECT ZASHO, ZASU FROM &LIB/VFYZLEG ORDER BY ZASHO
SELECT ZASHO, ZASU FROM &LIB/VFYZNEW ORDER BY ZASHO
SELECT COUNT(*) AS LEG_MINUS_NEW FROM (SELECT ZASHO, ZASU FROM &LIB/VFYZLEG EXCEPT SELECT ZASHO, ZASU FROM &LIB/VFYZNEW) X
SELECT COUNT(*) AS NEW_MINUS_LEG FROM (SELECT ZASHO, ZASU FROM &LIB/VFYZNEW EXCEPT SELECT ZASHO, ZASU FROM &LIB/VFYZLEG) X
SELECT SEQ, TESTNM, EXPECTED, ACTUAL, RESULT FROM &LIB/TESTRES ORDER BY SEQ
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN RESULT = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PASS_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN RESULT <> 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAIL_CNT FROM &LIB/TESTRES
SELECT LESSON, SEQNBR, OBJNAME, OBJTYPE FROM &LIB/VFYCKM ORDER BY SEQNBR
SELECT 'JUCHUM' AS T, COUNT(*) AS N FROM &LIB/JUCHUM UNION ALL SELECT 'JUCHUD', COUNT(*) FROM &LIB/JUCHUD UNION ALL SELECT 'ZAIKOM', COUNT(*) FROM &LIB/ZAIKOM
SELECT ZASHO, ZASU FROM &LIB/ZAIKOM ORDER BY ZASHO

SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN ('ZA0500', 'ZA0STM', 'ZAISRV', 'ZAISRVBD', 'TESTKIT', 'TESTKITBD', 'TSTZA0500', 'RUNTEST') ORDER BY OBJNAME, OBJTYPE
SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB2', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN ('ZA0ORIG', 'ZA0500', 'ZAISRV')
